implementation_constraints: Single executable file at source/impl.py, intended to run as python impl.py.
Reads all of stdin once, writes only stdout, and never performs filesystem or network I/O.
All malformed input paths print exactly ERROR and allow normal process termination with exit code 0.

unresolved_intent.decision: Reject objects with extra or missing keys at the top level, model, field, and event levels.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The package defines precise JSON shapes and classifies shape errors as malformed input, so strict key validation is the least ambiguous interpretation.

unresolved_intent.decision: Reject input events whose value is not a string, even when the target field is a string.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The model supports only string and bool field values, and input is specified as setting a string field; accepting another JSON type would introduce an unsupported field value.

unresolved_intent.decision: Preserve field insertion order from the initial model when building the output fields object.
unresolved_intent.rationale: JSON object order is not semantically required, but preserving model order keeps the view deterministic and aligns with the errors field-order rule.

unresolved_intent.decision: Determine field kind from the initial model value and preserve a separate initial-values mapping for reset.
unresolved_intent.rationale: Reset must restore the born-with model exactly, and event type checks should remain tied to the declared initial field kind.
